'''Gideon''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]. He crewed aboard the ''[[Independent Class]]'' with the [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]] [[Keeta]]. While on a stopover at [[Centares/Legends|Centares]], Gideon killed the [[Shi'ido]] [[Vandolae]], who was posing as [[Pyrron Nox]].<ref name="SS" />
